1.stem_plain: Hui Hui hid ________ the tree while playing hide-and-seek.

2.stem_plain: John ________ absent from school yesterday as he had a fever.

3.stem_plain: Mr Bala and his family ________ deeply saddened when they heard the terrible news.

4.stem_plain: "Listen carefully to what I ________ now. If you see a bear in the forest, do not go near," the camp instructor reminded us.

5.stem_plain: This morning, we ________ at the airport for a long time before boarding the plane.

6.stem_plain: While Marianne ________ on stage, the audience clapped and sang along.

7.stem_plain: "Come over here and help me carry ________ heavy bags of flour," the chef instructed.

8.stem_plain: We should clear the leftover food when we are done eating ________ it will attract unwanted pests.

9.stem_plain: Lily has ________ toys so her mother told her to give some away.

10.stem_plain: Father had cooked too ________ rice so our family did not have enough to eat.

1.note: 玩捉迷藏（hide-and-seek）时，通常是躲在树的“后面”，故选 behind。
1.zh: 慧慧玩捉迷藏时躲在树后面。

2.note: 句中有明确的过去时间状语 “yesterday”（昨天），主语 “John” 是第三人称单数，因此系动词用 “was”。
2.concept: 主谓一致与时态 — Subject-Verb Agreement & Tense — Past Tense (Singular)
2.zh: 约翰昨天因为发烧没去上学。

3.note: “when” 引导的时间状语从句使用的是过去时（heard），主句也应使用过去时；主语是 “Mr Bala and his family”（复数），因此用 “were”。
3.concept: 主谓一致与时态 — Subject-Verb Agreement & Tense — Past Tense (Plural)
3.zh: 巴拉先生和他的家人听到这个糟糕的消息时深感悲痛。

4.note: 句中有提示语 “Listen carefully”（仔细听）和时间副词 “now”（现在），表明说话人正在进行的动作，需用现在进行时。
4.concept: 动词时态 — Verb Tenses — Present Continuous Tense
4.zh: “仔细听我现在说的话。如果你们在森林里看到熊，不要靠近，”营地指导员提醒我们道。

5.note: 时间状语 “This morning”（今天早上）配合后文的 “before boarding the plane”（登机前），表明“等待”这一动作发生在过去并已结束，需用一般过去时。
5.concept: 动词时态 — Verb Tenses — Simple Past Tense
5.zh: 今天早上，我们在机场等了很久才登机。

6.note: “While” 引导的时间状语从句表示一个持续性的背景动作，与主句中观众的过去动作（clapped and sang）相对比，从句需用过去进行时。
6.concept: 动词时态 — Verb Tenses — Past Continuous Tense
6.zh: 当玛丽安在舞台上表演时，观众们拍手并跟着一起唱。

7.note: 说话者使用了 “Come over here”（到这里来），表明物品距离较近；且修饰的 “heavy bags”（重袋子）为复数名词，因此选用近指复数指示代词 “these”。
7.concept: 指示代词 — Demonstrative Pronouns — these
7.zh: “到这里来，帮我搬这些沉重的面粉袋，”厨师吩咐道。

8.note: 此处使用连词 “or” 表示“否则”（否则就会招来讨厌的害虫），用以引出不采取前述行动的负面后果。
8.zh: 我们吃完饭后应该把剩菜剩饭清理干净，否则会招来讨厌的害虫。

9.note: “toys” 是可数名词复数，不能用 little 或 much 修饰；结合后文“妈妈让她把一些送人”，说明玩具“很多”，故选 many。
9.concept: 数量词修饰 — Quantifiers — countable nouns
9.zh: 莉莉有很多玩具，所以她妈妈让她送一些出去。

10.note: “rice” 是不可数名词，不能用 few 或 many 修饰；结合后文 “did not have enough to eat”（不够吃），可知父亲做的饭“太少”，故选 little。
10.concept: 数量词修饰 — Quantifiers — uncountable nouns
10.zh: 父亲晚饭时做的米饭太少了，所以我们一家人都不够吃。

11.stem_plain: The squirrel found ____________ tree trunk and used it to store its acorns.

12.stem_plain: The campers took a week's worth of food ____________ on their camping trip.

13.stem_plain: They desperately ____________ water out of the canoe but more water kept rushing into it.

14.stem_plain: Wei Ming got hooked reading a story about a detective trying to figure out an ____________ mystery.

15.stem_plain: Mr Wong loves his daughter and often praises her. She is clearly ____________.

16.stem_plain: Mrs Abdullah loves her baby very much and cuddles her ____________ at bedtime every day.

11.zh: 松鼠发现了一个中空的树干，并用它来储存橡果。
11.note: “a hollow”意为“中空的”，常用来修饰树干（tree trunk），指内部有洞可以存放东西。

choices.eg: Please write your name and index number in the blank space provided.
He drank the warm milk and left the empty glass on the dining table.
The wild owls made their nest inside a hollow log in the forest.

12.zh: 野营者们在他们的野营旅行中带了够吃一周的食物补给。
12.note: “supplies”在这里与“food”搭配，指“食物补给、生活必需品”。

choices.eg: The laboratory is filled with advanced scientific equipment for experiments.
The rescue workers distributed medical supplies to the flood victims.

choices.zh: 器皿、用具（尤指厨房用具）
choices.eg: She washed the cooking utensils carefully after baking the chocolate cake.
The professional climbers wore heavy protective gear to brave the snowstorm.

13.zh: 他们拼命地把水从独木舟里舀出来，但更多的水不断涌进来。
13.note: “scooped”意思是“（用手或工具）舀、掏”，符合把进水的船只向外排水的动作语境。

choices.eg: She poured a fresh cup of hot tea for her grandfather.
They paddled their small canoe down the calm river during the holiday.
The boy scooped some dry sand into his colorful plastic bucket.
He squeezed the wet sponge to get rid of the excess water.

14.zh: 伟明读一个关于侦探试图解开未解之谜的故事入了迷。
14.note: “unsolved”意思是“未解决的、未破案的”，常与“mystery（谜团）”搭配，符合侦探小说的经典设定。

choices.eg: The instructions on the board were unclear, leaving the students confused.
The police are still investigating the unsolved robbery from last year.
A pile of unopened letters lay on the desk near the main door.
He left his painting unfinished because he had to rush out for an emergency.

15.zh: 黄先生疼爱他的女儿，并且经常夸奖她。她显然是他的掌上明珠。
15.note: “the apple of his eye”是固定习语，意思是“掌上明珠、心肝宝贝”，形容非常珍视和疼爱的人。

choices.eg: Tell me what happened during the trip, I am all ears.
She has a sweet tooth and always orders dessert after dinner.
The brand new smartphone cost me an arm and a leg.
The little girl is the apple of her grandfather's eye.

16.zh: 阿卜杜拉夫人非常爱她的宝宝，每天睡觉时都会深情地拥抱她。
16.note: “affectionately”意思是“深情地、充满关爱地”，修饰搂抱（cuddles）的动作，完美体现出母亲对宝宝的爱。

choices.eg: The actress spoke emotionally about her difficult journey to success.
He closed the door considerately so as not to wake the sleeping infant.
The dog wagged its tail and licked its owner's hand affectionately.
The audience applauded appreciatively after the beautiful musical performance.

21.note: 解释为什么选这个答案 — replace stems, passages, and teaching copy when content is ready.

17.note: 动词 showed 的宾语，指代前文的“我们（we）”，故选 us。

18.note: 作句子主语，指代前文单数男性的导游 'The guide'（由后文的 told us 可推断其为主语），故选 he。

19.note: 与 own 搭配修饰名词 portraits，指代“我们自己的”，故选 our。

20.note: 使役动词 helped 的宾语，结合后文“I found...”以及“I hope...”，说明是帮助“我”更好地欣赏艺术，故选 me。

cloze: Yesterday, we went on a learning journey to the National Gallery Singapore. The guide showed [Q17] paintings and sculptures by local artists. [Q18] told us stories about the paintings and explained how the artists created the sculptures. We did an activity where we drew [Q19] own portraits. I found the trip fun and meaningful as it helped [Q20] appreciate art more. I hope to visit the place again.
zh: 昨天，我们去新加坡国家美术馆进行了一次学习之旅。导游向我们展示了当地艺术家的画作和雕塑。他给我们讲了关于这些画作的故事，并解释了艺术家们是如何创作这些雕塑的。我们做了一个活动，在活动中我们画了我们自己的肖像画。我觉得这次旅行既有趣又有意义，因为它帮助我更好地欣赏艺术。我希望以后能再次参观这个地方。

27.stem_plain: The netball player did not take part in the match. Her ankle was injured.

28.stem_plain: Mr Lee will not play golf for a month. He will also not run for a month.

27.zh: 那位脚踝受伤的净网球运动员没有参加比赛。
27.note: whose 是表示所属关系的关系代词。用其替换第二句中的形容词性物主代词 Her，并将整个定语从句紧跟在它所修饰的先行词 The netball player 后面。
27.answer: The netball player whose ankle was injured did not take part in the match.

28.concept: 否定连词 — Correlative Conjunction ('neither ... nor ...')
28.zh: 李先生在一个月内既不会打高尔夫球，也不会跑步。
28.note: neither ... nor ... 意为“既不……也不……”，本身自带否定含义。因此在合并句子时，原句中的否定词 not 必须去掉，同时省略两句中重复的时间状语 for a month。
28.answer: Mr Lee will neither play golf nor run for a month.

41.stem_plain: Alek was getting away from the _______________ that was affecting his country. [1m]

42.stem_plain: These are some statements describing the events of the story. Put them in the right order according to the story. Write 1, 2 and 3 on the lines. [1m]
events: The old woman told Alek that she could not take him with her.
Alek got separated from his family.

43.stem_plain:
Why was it dangerous for the old woman to take Alek along with her? [1m]
[Write your answer using a complete sentence / complete sentences.]

45(a).stem_plain: How did Alek feel when he was scanning the faces of the people from the Dinka tribe? Give one word to describe how Alek felt.

46.stem_plain:
State whether each sentence below is True or False. Give a reason for your answer. [2m]
[Write your reasons using complete sentences.]

rows: (a) Alek saw his family among the people of the Dinka tribe.
(b) When the old woman first told the group to take Alek along with them, they welcomed the idea.

47.stem_plain: Which of the following words best describe the woman carrying a baby and the leader of the group in lines 15 - 23? Put a tick (✓) in one box for each character to show your answer. [2m]

41.note: 对应原文第10行：老妇人对他说 'Wherever you go, just walk away from the fighting.' 这里的 'fighting' 指代的就是前文提到的战争 (war)。故选 (1)。

42.note: 对应故事的时间顺序：首先他在前文已经和家人失散了 (1)；接着第4-5行老妇人告诉阿莱克不能带他一起走 (2)；随后在第6行阿莱克温顺地提问为什么不行，即索要解释 (3)。因此排序为 2, 1, 3。

43.note: 对应原文第7-8行：'The soldiers will leave an old woman like me alone. But, they'll take you away to fight along with them.' 士兵会抓走他去一起打仗。要求用完整句子回答。
43.answer: The soldiers would take Alek away to fight along with them.

44.note: 对应原文第8-9行：'The old woman shook her head in sympathy...' 这里的 'shook her head in sympathy' 正好是由5个单词组成的短语，表达了同情与可怜之情。

45.note: 对应第五自然段（第11-14行）。(a) 描写他看面孔时‘屏住呼吸’，没找到时‘失望长叹’。说明在看那些面孔时内心是‘hopeful’(充满希望)的。(b) 他期待着在人群中发现自己的家人（'Could his family be among them?'）。

answer.Q45b: was expecting to see his family among the people from the Dinka tribe.

46.note:
(a) 对应原文第13行 'only the faces of strangers greeted him'，他只看到了陌生人的脸，并没有看到家人，所以是False。
(b) 对应原文第17-18行 老妇人询问是否能带他走后，大家‘一片沉默’并且‘交换了不安的眼神’，说明他们最初并没有欣然接受这个提议，所以是False。

answer.46c: Only the faces of strangers greeted Alek when he scanned the faces of the people.
answer.46d: The people exchanged uneasy glances and fell into silence when the old woman asked them to take Alek with them.

47.note: 抱婴儿的妇女说‘我真为这个男孩感到难过。没有家人，他一定很害怕’，展现了极强的同理心，选 empathetic；首领听到后直接点头说‘我们会带上他’，表现得非常果断，选 decisive。

lines.1: "Boom!" Another explosion. Alek hoped his family were safe. He wondered when he
lines.2: would see them again. Last year, Alek did not have enough to eat during the famine. But this
lines.4: A raspy old voice broke his thoughts. "The drought is coming. I've to find a place with
lines.5: water. You cannot come with me."
lines.7: "It would be dangerous for you to travel with me. The soldiers will leave an old woman
lines.8: like me alone. But, they'll take you away to fight along with them." The old woman shook her
lines.9: head in sympathy and continued, "I pity you but I can't help you anymore. Wherever you go,
lines.10: just walk away from the fighting."
lines.11: Disheartened, Alek sat down on a rock quietly until he saw people approaching. They
lines.12: were from the Dinka tribe, too! Alek held his breath as he scanned the faces. Could his
lines.13: family be among them? However, only the faces of strangers greeted him. He heaved a sigh
lines.15: The old woman asked their leader, "Where are you going?"
lines.16: He replied with a smile, "We're going to the other side of the River Nile. Thank you for
lines.17: welcoming us." The old woman put her hand on Alek's shoulder. "He's alone, separated from
lines.18: his family. Will you take him with you?" Silence. Alek saw the people exchange uneasy
lines.19: glances. Sensing he would be left behind again, Alek hung his head.
lines.20: "I feel so sorry for the boy. He must be so scared without his family," a woman carrying
lines.21: a baby commented, casting a glance at Alek. The leader nodded and said, "We'll take him with
lines.22: us." Alek's eyes brimmed with tears, grateful for all the kindness shown to him thus far.

paragraphs.1: “轰！”又是一声爆炸。阿莱克希望他的家人能安全。他不知道什么时候能再见到他们。去年，在饥荒期间，阿莱克没有足够的食物。但是这场战争更糟糕。
paragraphs.4: 一个沙哑的老人的声音打断了他的思绪。“干旱要来了。我必须找一个有水的地方。你不能跟我一起去。”
paragraphs.6: 阿莱克温顺地问：“为什么不行呢？”
paragraphs.7: “你和我一起走会很危险。士兵们不会为难我这样一个老太婆。但是，他们会把你带走，让你和他们一起战斗。”老妇人同情地摇了摇头，继续说道：“我为你感到难过，但我不能再帮你了。不管你走到哪里，只要远离战斗就好。”
paragraphs.11: 沮丧的阿莱克静静地坐在一块石头上，直到他看到有人走过来。他们也是丁卡部落的！阿莱克屏住呼吸，扫视着那些面孔。他的家人会在他们中间吗？然而，迎来的却只有陌生人的面孔。他失望地长叹了一口气。他们去哪儿了？
paragraphs.15: 老妇人问他们的首领：“你们要去哪里？”
paragraphs.16: 他微笑着回答说：“我们要去尼罗河的另一边。谢谢你欢迎我们。”老妇人把手放在阿莱克的肩膀上。“他一个人，和家人失散了。你们能带他一起走吗？”一片沉默。阿莱克看到人们交换了不安的眼神。意识到自己可能会再次被留下，阿莱克低下了头。
paragraphs.20: “我真为这个男孩感到难过。没有家人，他一定很害怕，”一个抱着婴儿的妇女评论道，并看了阿莱克一眼。首领点了点头，说：“我们带他一起走吧。”阿莱克眼里含满了泪水，感激至今为止向他展示的所有善意。
